description: This PHP class defines a Drupal 7 migration source plugin for extracting taxonomy term entity translations, including methods for querying the source database, preparing data rows, and defining source fields.

classes.name: TermEntityTranslation
classes.description: A Drupal 7 migration source plugin class for taxonomy term entity translations, extending FieldableEntity.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Builds and returns a database query to retrieve taxonomy term translation data, with optional filtering by bundle.

methods.name: prepareRow
methods.description: Prepares each data row by fetching field values, handling translation, and replacing name/description if using the Title module.

methods.name: fields
methods.description: Defines the list of source fields available for this migration, including entity info, translation details, and term data.

methods.name: getIds
methods.description: Specifies the primary key fields for the source data: entity_id and language.
